description: A working apple orchard in Palm Boulevard, FL, Metrozoo MetroBoo grows Apples, Corn, Honey, Eggs, and Oranges. The orchard is busiest in winter. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jul – Oct in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
